Name: Dioxer the Alien (Custom NPC)
Author: 8BitAlien
Description:
[center]﻿[/center]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/aaHi17Z.png[/img]

Dioxer didn't visit the Valley intentionally; his spaceship ended up crashing by the ocean and he wound up creating a new cave for himself on the Beach to seek refuge from the unfamiliarity of humankind. Maybe befriending this untrusting alien could make him warm up to you? And who knows what might happen if Dioxer gains some confidence? This mod can be added mid save or to a new one.

[spoiler]Dioxer will become confident enough to leave his cave when 6 hearts are reached. He will then have a schedule around the Valley. [/spoiler]

                                                                                         [img]https://i.imgur.com/rz4UXYJ.png[/img]

Dioxer's Cave is a new location full of valuable ores and other precious rocks! Forageable items can also spawn in this special cave. [spoiler]The rocks within Dioxer Cave scale to the player's mining level. The rarer rocks and ores will spawn when the player has a higher mining level to keep things fair and balanced. [/spoiler]

Gifting Dioxer:
[spoiler]
Loved Gifts:
Esperite
Jade
Void Egg
Strange Doll (green)

Liked Gifts:
Battery Pack
Squid Ink
Radioactive Bar
Emerald

Disliked Gifts:
Banana 
Sap
Triple Shot Espresso
Coffee

Hated Gifts:
Any fish
[/spoiler]
